scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,ollama,app -c blue,magenta,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:ollama" "bun run dev:app"
scripts.dev:app: bun scripts/prune-incremental.ts && bun --filter desktop tauri dev
scripts.build: bun --filter server compile && VITE_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:47321 bun --filter desktop tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.build:mac: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0 && bun --filter server compile && VITE_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:47321 bun --filter desktop tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json --bundles dmg
